name: <str> Identifier of the underlying Li & Lim PDPTW instance.
num_nodes: <int> Total number of nodes including the depot. Node 0 is the depot; nodes 1..num_nodes-1 are pickup and drop-off locations.
num_requests: <int> Number of transport requests. Each request contributes exactly one pickup node and one drop-off node.
max_vehicles: <int> Hard upper bound on the number of vehicles that may be used. A plan using more vehicles is infeasible.
coordinates: <list of [<int> x, <int> y]> Location of each node, indexed from 0. Travel time and distance between two nodes equal the Euclidean distance between their coordinates rounded to the nearest integer.
demand: <list of <int>> Load change at each node: positive at a pickup, the matching negative value at its drop-off, zero at the depot.
time_window: <list of [<int> earliest, <int> latest]> Interval during which service may begin at each node. Arriving earlier is allowed and the vehicle waits; arriving later is infeasible. Entry 0 bounds the working day at the depot.
service_time: <list of <int>> Time spent serving each node; zero at the depot.
requests: <list of [<int> pickup, <int> delivery]> The transport requests. Both nodes of a request must be served by the same vehicle, with the pickup earlier in that vehicle's route.
